messages:
Elaine: quick update — pricing experiment v4 ready for limited rollout. plan to flip cohorts Thurs 08:00 PT. please review grandfather rules and opt-out flow: https://g.co/redwood/pricing-v4.
Sam: what's the experiment split and primary guardrail?
Elaine: split 40% control / 60% variant. guardrail = no invoice line changes for committed deals; monitor invoice delta T+24h, target <4%.
Raj: billing asks: need cohort CSV mapped to billing_account_id and a reconciliation key to avoid double billing. I'll run a compare job post-cutover.
Priya: Support will accept opt-out tickets. recommend support-only opt-outs for first 48h to audit. we'll tag tickets with `pricing_v4_optout`.
Olivia: Legal: auto-grandfather for contracts signed before 2025-03-01 until 2027-03-01. must include explicit notice line in communications.
Sam: ops should run a canary of 75 accounts (L/M/H mix). Marco, can you confirm?
Elaine: Marco is OOO today; I'll assign to Priya for canary coordination. need CSV by Wed 5pm.
Raj: sample reconciliation query I'll run:
```
SELECT acct_id, period, old_units, new_units, (new_units-old_units) AS tokens_delta
FROM billing_compare
WHERE period = '2026-07'
```
billing-bot: File uploaded: pricing-v4-cohort.csv (Elaine) :file_folder:
Elaine: final: freeze cohort Wed 17:00 PT. drop exceptions into the sheet. I'll lock at cutoff and post final list. :thumbsup:
